Product added to enquiry Product added to project Choose the Cisco license that suits your needs Change the Cisco license type Choose add-ons The Cisco license is assigned to the entire organization, not to an individual device. Changing the license type for this product will be applied to all Cisco devices in the cart. This is due to the Co-term licensing model, in which the entire organization must use a single, consistent license type – Enterprise or Advanced. They cannot be combined, so if your organization already uses an Enterprise license, an Advanced license cannot be added – and vice versa. A license is not just access to a device – it is a continuously evolving network management platform. Throughout the subscription period Cisco regularly releases software updates, new features and security improvements that are delivered to your device automatically. By purchasing a license you can be confident that your network runs on current software and is protected against new threats – at no extra cost and without involving IT. BASIC Enterprise License Basic tier – sufficient for most SMB companies. Management via the Meraki Dashboard Automatic firmware updates Real-time monitoring and alerts VLAN, QoS and port configuration Cisco technical support ADVANCED Advanced License Extended version for companies with security and network analytics requirements. Everything in the Enterprise license Adaptive Policy (traffic segmentation) Netflow v10 and encrypted traffic analysis Advanced reporting Note: in the Co-term licensing model the entire organization must have a uniform license type (either exclusively Enterprise or exclusively Advanced). If your organization already has devices with an Enterprise license, you cannot add an Advanced license – and vice versa. The device includes a built-in perpetual Network license, while Cisco DNA features require an active subscription. Choose the subscription variant and term.
